NICHES.name: Private clinics — dental, derma, physio
NICHES.market: Bahrain first, then Saudi via referrals
NICHES.pain: Every unanswered WhatsApp after hours is a lost 30–200 BHD appointment; no-shows quietly eat 10–20% of revenue; reception can't cover evenings or weekends.
NICHES.offer: Bilingual (Arabic/English) WhatsApp receptionist: booking, reminders that cut no-shows, FAQ, and review requests.
NICHES.edge: Your Arabic+English agent already exists; patients live on WhatsApp; the owner-doctor answers their own phone — one decision-maker, fast close.
NICHES.verdict: THE PICK. Real budgets, monthly retainers, and the same build resells to every clinic in the Gulf.

NICHES.name: Car rental & dealerships
NICHES.pain: Huge after-hours inquiry volume; the first responder wins the booking; staff drown in repetitive availability questions.
NICHES.offer: WhatsApp agent for instant availability, qualification, and booking handoff.
NICHES.edge: Inquiry volume makes ROI obvious in week one.
NICHES.verdict: Strong #2 — bigger tickets than salons, but the owner is harder to reach than a clinic's.

NICHES.name: Restaurants & cafés
NICHES.market: Bahrain — you know this world from the inside
NICHES.pain: Missed reservations and order questions during rush hours; no one owns the WhatsApp inbox.
NICHES.edge: You RAN a coffee shop — instant credibility and vocabulary with owners.
NICHES.verdict: Fallback #1 — fastest doors to open for your first 1–2 logos, but budgets are thin and churn is high. Don't build the business here.

NICHES.name: Salons & aesthetic studios
NICHES.pain: Booking chaos across Instagram DMs and WhatsApp; no-shows on peak slots.
NICHES.offer: Booking + reminder agent unified over WhatsApp/Instagram.
NICHES.verdict: Volume play — good for confidence reps early, bad for margin. Graduate out fast.

NICHES.name: Real-estate agencies (your paused niche)
NICHES.pain: Speed-to-lead decides who gets the viewing; agents leak leads constantly.
NICHES.offer: Instant lead-response + qualification agent feeding a sheet/CRM.
NICHES.edge: You know the players from last time.
NICHES.verdict: Parked, deliberately. Commission-driven owners haggle, retainers churn when the market cools, and momentum here was already lost once. Reopen only on a warm referral.

NICHES.name: Law & consulting firms
NICHES.pain: Expensive partners doing free phone triage; unqualified consults burn billable hours.
NICHES.verdict: Wrong for now — conservative buyers and a 2-month sales cycle you can't afford at ≤2h/day. Phase 2 candidate.
